findings.message: json_esc escapes only backslash, double quote, newline and tab. A carriage return or any other control character below 0x20 goes into the JSON string raw, which makes the whole ledger line invalid JSON. Escape the full control-character class (\r, \b, \f, and \u00XX for the rest), or build the line with a real encoder. CATEGORY and PRIORITY are interpolated with no escaping at all, so validate or escape them as well. The test covers only the double-quote variant.
findings.scenario: specclaw-log-learning <dir> <change> pattern high $'line1\rline2' 'x' appends a line containing a raw 0x0D inside "detail". json.loads on that line raises 'Invalid control character', so any structured reader of timeline.jsonl fails or drops the lesson.

findings.message: The `dash` feature tells users to run `/plugin install specclaw-dash@chan4lk`, but this diff adds no specclaw-dash plugin and no specclaw-dash entry to marketplace.json. Every plugin in this diff is bumped to 0.9.7, and none of them is specclaw-dash. skills/status/SKILL.md runs the dash tip on every status call. Either ship the plugin, or remove the dash feature and its call site until the plugin exists. The AC-1 to AC-4 tests never exercise the dash tip against a real plugin.
findings.scenario: Run /specclaw:status with specclaw-dash not installed. The output shows 'Tip: one pane shows the build, review and learning loops. Install: /plugin install specclaw-dash@chan4lk'. Following it fails because the marketplace has no such plugin.

findings.message: The command-to-plugin mapping (specclaw-bf-status/specclaw-bf and specclaw-gh-sync/specclaw-sync) now exists twice: as hard-coded arguments to `missing` in hooks/session-start and in the feature() table in specclaw-suggest. The hook never reads `plugins.dismissed`, so a dismissal made through specclaw-suggest does not apply to the hook's install notices. Move the feature table into lib/plugins.sh and have the hook honour `plugins.dismissed`.
findings.scenario: A user runs `specclaw-suggest .specclaw --dismiss sync` and `--dismiss bf`. With github.sync: true, or with .specclaw/analysis present, the next session-start still injects '## Missing specclaw plugins' telling them to install specclaw-sync and specclaw-bf.

findings.message: The AC-6 check shells out to python3, but CLAUDE.md describes the suites as bash + coreutils only. AC-5 only greps for the string 'lib/plugins.sh', so it does not prove the hook still emits its notices after the refactor. No test drives the hook with and without the lib present.
findings.scenario: On a runner without python3, AC-6 fails with 'command not found' and is indistinguishable from a real defect. Breaking the hook's notice path while keeping the source line leaves AC-5 green.
